Selected work

Golden Sats Challenge DeFi campaign

A multi-partner DeFi campaign that contributed to over $100M in trading volume. It brought ecosystem partners together, coordinated user acquisition and encouraged real participation in DeFi rather than awareness alone.

RIF Me Up Developer acquisition

A launch combining developer acquisition, in-person activations and on-chain engagement to support token adoption. It sits alongside Cultivators, an on-chain programme built to encourage recurring ecosystem engagement.

Institutional go-to-market Bitcoin finance

Demand generation for Bitcoin lending, borrowing, yield and Vault products, built with Business Development. Full-funnel programs from awareness to sales activation using webinars, lead magnets, LinkedIn Ads, newsletters and HubSpot.

Events & hackathons Ecosystem growth

End-to-end ownership of event and hackathon programs: strategy, budgets, partnerships, logistics, marketing and execution. Over 20 hackathons and 20 international events, building relationships across protocols, partners and communities.

Account-based marketing & co-marketing B2B partnerships

ABM programs aimed at leading fintech companies, with tailored campaigns, industry events and executive networking. Co-marketing with ecosystem partners, from joint messaging and landing pages to distribution and activation.

RevOps & AI tooling Marketing operations

HubSpot workflows, CRM-integrated lead capture applications and AI-powered tools built with Claude and Replit. Faster lead capture, cleaner handoffs to BD and less manual work.
